I am currently looking for two PhD researchers to join my new research group ENACT – Exploring New Assemblies of Communities & Smart Technologies in Urban Spaces at the University of Siegen, Germany.

ENACT is a five-year research project funded by the Volkswagen Foundation. We explore how smart and autonomous technologies might shape social encounters in urban public space, combining Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Design Research, and artistic research in close collaboration with the Forum Freies Theater (FFT) Düsseldorf and international artists.

We are hiring for two complementary profiles:

PhD Researcher – Speculative Design & Social Interaction

Develop and investigate speculative scenarios of how technologies might shape social encounters in urban public space, using speculative and performative design methods.

PhD Researcher – Interaction Design & Physical Prototyping

Design and build interactive technologies and explore new forms of interaction between people and technologies through prototypes and interventions in urban public space.

Both positions are full-time (100%, TV-L E13) and offer the opportunity to develop an independent PhD project within ENACT.

Application deadline: November 15, 2026

Please feel free to share this announcement with anyone who might be interested.
